levels.surface: الحسن بن حازم الكلبي ابن أخت هشام بن سالم

notes: «ابن أخت هشام بن سالم» is a description attached to the same man with no verb: kept with his name
«وَ لَيْسَ بِالْجَعْفَرِيِّ» is a remark on Sulayman: left out
Imam after «عن» stays a narrator; the Prophet's words and Ali's and Jibril's words inside the matn are not separate isnads and add no link
